canonical_example.text: Roztrhal mé nejlepší tričko. Až ho uvidím, tak ho zabiju!
canonical_example.translation: He's torn my best shirt. When I see him, I'll kill him!

meanings.translation: to kill (to express one’s anger at)

canonical_example.text: Zabil se kvůli depresi.
canonical_example.translation: He committed suicide because of depression.

meanings.translation: to commit suicide, to get killed, to be killed

canonical_example.text: Jak dlouho mohou vydržet bez vody?
canonical_example.translation: How long can they hold out without water?

canonical_example.text: Tak drahé auto si nemůžeme dovolit.
canonical_example.translation: We cannot afford to buy such an expensive car.

canonical_example.text: Co si to dovolujete?
canonical_example.translation: How dare you?

canonical_example.text: No dovol.
canonical_example.translation: Well excuse me!

canonical_example.text: Má na vás otázku ohledně večeře, pane.
canonical_example.translation: He has a question for you regarding dinner, sir.

canonical_example.text: Budu běžet ze všech sil.
canonical_example.translation: I will run like my life depends on it.

canonical_example.text: Alena a Petr si spolu dobře rozumí.
canonical_example.translation: Alena and Petr understand each other well.

meanings.translation: to understand (another person sympathetically); to sympathize with

canonical_example.text: Vůbec tomu nerozumím.
canonical_example.translation: I do not understand it at all.

canonical_example.text: To se rozumí samo sebou.
canonical_example.translation: That goes without saying.

canonical_example.text: Beru si nákupní košík, protože mám malý nákup.
canonical_example.translation: I'm taking a shopping basket (not a cart) because I have small items.

meanings.translation: to marry, to help yourself (to some food)

canonical_example.text: Berte tyhle léky třikrát denně.
canonical_example.translation: Take this medicine three times a day.

canonical_example.text: Petra a Pavel se v červnu budou brát.
canonical_example.translation: Petra and Paul will marry in June.

meanings.translation: to marry (to be joined together as spouses)

canonical_example.text: Za hrubý faul dostal stop na čtyři zápasy.
canonical_example.translation: He received a four-match suspension for a serious foul.

unused_menu_senses.translation: track (one section of a multitrack recording)

canonical_example.text: jednou vám vysvětlím, proč mu tak říkáme.
canonical_example.translation: One day I'll explain to you why we call him this.

canonical_example.text: Chtěla by dítě.
canonical_example.translation: She would like a child.

canonical_example.text: Šlo znovu o byznys, kde zájmy české republiky tvrdě narážely na zájmy vůdčích států Unie.
canonical_example.translation: It was again a business where the interests of the Czech Republic clashed hard with the interests of the leading states of the Union.

meanings.translation: interest (an involvement, claim, right, share, stake in or link with a financial, business, or other undertaking or endeavor)

canonical_example.text: Začal kouřit, když mu bylo dvacet let.
canonical_example.translation: He started to smoke when he was twenty years old.

canonical_example.text: Začali novou píseň.
canonical_example.translation: They started a new song.

canonical_example.text: Právě o to mi jde.
canonical_example.translation: That's exactly what I'm concerned about.

meanings.translation: to concern, matter, interest (to be at issue, to be at stake)

canonical_example.text: Nejde udělat všechno dobře, ale alespoň udělat většinu dobře by už mohlo jít!
canonical_example.translation: You can't do everything well, but at least you can do most of it well!

canonical_example.text: Budou tři stačit? To půjde.
canonical_example.translation: Will three be enough? It will do.

meanings.translation: which, that (the one or ones that)
to sit (to be in a sitting position)

canonical_example.text: Ty šaty ti nesedí.
canonical_example.translation: That dress doesn't fit you.
